About Beenorax

Four specialist divisions. One evidence-driven approach.

Beenorax Analytics & Consulting works across Public Health & Epidemiology, Business Intelligence & Analytics, Biomedical Research & Data Analytics, and Training & Capacity Development. These divisions connect population health evidence, biomedical and computational research, organisational performance data and professional skills.

Healthcare analytics division

Public Health & Epidemiology

Population health, disease patterns, health services, health systems and programme evidence to support planning, monitoring and informed decisions.

Biomedical research division

Biomedical Research & Data Analytics

Experimental, clinical and computational biomedical research, including bioinformatics, computational biology, molecular modelling and in silico analysis.

Business analytics division

Business Intelligence & Analytics

Financial, customer, workforce, operational and executive analytics that turn organisational data into useful management insight.

Professional development division

Training & Capacity Development

Practical training and professional development for researchers, analysts, laboratories, teams and institutions.
